titre: Dire si une personne correspond au persona visé
description: Avant de mettre un contact en séquence ou de le confier à un agent, Jev lit son titre LinkedIn, sa présentation et le descriptif de son entreprise, puis dit si la personne entre dans le persona visé. Le persona ci-dessous est un exemple (un cabinet qui vend de la prospection externalisée aux PME B2B cherche les dirigeants et directeurs commerciaux de PME françaises de 10 à 250 salariés) : à réécrire pour votre offre dans `persona`. Les oui sûrs partent en séquence, les lignes sous le seuil vont à un humain.

instructions.persona: Decision maker for commercial development in a French B2B SME with 10 to 250 employees: founder, CEO, managing director, sales director, head of sales, or head of business development. The company sells to other businesses (software, industry, business services, consulting, law). Excluded: freelancers and solo consultants, agencies and coaches who sell services to executives, companies selling mainly to consumers, public bodies and associations, groups above 250 employees, students and job seekers.
instructions.question: Given `persona`, does this person match it? Use `linkedin_headline` for the role, `about` for what they actually do, and `entreprise_description` for what the company sells and its size. When the headline and the about text disagree, trust the about text.

criteria.true: Role, company type and company size all fit the persona, or the only missing piece is a size that is simply not stated.
criteria.false: At least one element contradicts the persona: employee without commercial ownership, freelancer or consultant selling their own services, company selling mainly to consumers, public sector, association, group far above the size limit, student or job seeker.
